lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Concept model B: data and uncertainty

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Compare these two examples. Find the step where they stop being the same.

items.prompt: A model predicts a $80 rate will increase by 25%. What is the new rate?

steps: Identify what the problem is asking and which quantities, assumptions, or constraints matter.
Build and solve a model, then check the result against the context.

items.prompt: A storage container is 4 by 3 by 2 feet. What is its volume in cubic feet?

steps: Identify what the problem is asking and which quantities, assumptions, or constraints matter.
Build and solve a model, then check the result against the context.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: A data set has the values 16, 26, 36, 46, 56. The mean is 36. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?
A student claims a box that is 6 by 3 by 2 units has a volume of 18 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: No; the volume is 20 cubic units, not 18.
No; the volume is 19 cubic units, not 18.
Cannot be determined from the given information.
No; the volume is 36 cubic units, not 18.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $6 base fee plus $6 per hour. A customer's total bill was $30. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A diver starts at the surface (0 m) and descends 19 m, then descends another 5 m, then ascends 5 m. The dive plan assumes a depth limit of 33 m below the surface. What is the diver's final position, as a signed number of meters?
A model predicts a $400 rate will increase by 10%. What does the model predict as the new rate?
A storage container is designed as a rectangular prism 14 ft long, 2 ft wide, and 11 ft high. What is its volume in cubic feet?
A data set has the values 11, 21, 31, 41, 51. The mean is 31. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: A student claims a box that is 6 by 6 by 4 units has a volume of 16 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: No; the volume is 144 cubic units, not 16.
Cannot be determined from the given information.
No; the volume is 18 cubic units, not 16.
No; the volume is 17 cubic units, not 16.
